description: This Java class defines a read-only implementation of a Map Entry, called ReadOnlyMapEntry. It provides immutable access to key-value pairs with overridden methods for key retrieval, value retrieval, and equality checks. The class is part of the Apache OFBiz framework and appears to be a utility class for use throughout the project.

classes.name: ReadOnlyMapEntry
classes.description: A read-only, immutable implementation of Map.Entry suitable for use where modification of key-value pairs is not allowed.

methods.name: ReadOnlyMapEntry
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the key and value for this map entry.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key corresponding to this entry.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value corresponding to this entry.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Throws UnsupportedOperationException to prevent modification of the value.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this entry is equal to another object, based on key and value equality.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code for this entry, combining the key and value hash codes.
